A channel has hydraulic radius 0.4 m, bed slope 0.003 and Manning n = 0.025. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
A channel of area 3.0 m2 and hydraulic radius 0.5 m has slope 0.001 and n = 0.013. Calculate the discharge in m3/s.
A Froude model is built to a scale of 1:25 and discharges 0.05 m3/s. Find the prototype discharge in m3/s.
items.s: Under Froude law Q scales by L^(5/2): Qp = 0.05 x 25^2.5 = 156.2 m3/s.

items.q: A body of frontal area 2.0 m2 moves through water at 10 m/s with drag coefficient 0.4. Find the drag force in kN.
A pump lifts 0.02 m3/s against a total head of 25 m with overall efficiency 0.65. Find the shaft power required in kW.
items.s: Water power = rho g Q H = 4.91 kW; shaft power = 4.91/0.65 = 7.55 kW.

items.q: A pipe 100 m long and 100 mm diameter carries water at 2.0 m/s with f = 0.006. Calculate the friction head loss in m.
A total discharge of 0.12 m3/s splits into two parallel pipes, one carrying 0.02 m3/s. Find the discharge in the other pipe in m3/s.
items.s: Discharges divide while head loss is common: Q2 = 0.12 - 0.02 = 0.1 m3/s.

items.q: A turbine takes 1.2 m3/s at a net head of 20 m and delivers 120 kW. Calculate its efficiency in percent.
items.s: Input power = rho g Q H = 235.44 kW; efficiency = 120/235.44 x 100 = 50.97%.

items.q: Oil of viscosity 0.05 N s/m2 flows through a 30 mm pipe 10 m long under a pressure drop of 800 N/m2. Find the discharge in litres per second.
Three pipes in series have head losses of 4.0 m, 3.5 m and 0.5 m. Find the total head loss in m.
items.s: Losses add in series: 4.0 + 3.5 + 0.5 = 8 m.

items.q: A channel has hydraulic radius 0.6 m, bed slope 0.002 and Manning n = 0.02. Find the mean velocity in m/s.

Using Chezy with C = 50, hydraulic radius 0.5 m and slope 0.002, find the velocity in m/s.
items.s: V = C sqrt(R S) = 50 x sqrt(0.5 x 0.002) = 1.58 m/s.

items.q: A problem involves 8 variables and 3 fundamental dimensions. How many dimensionless pi terms does the Buckingham theorem give?
items.s: Number of pi terms = n - m = 8 - 3 = 5.

a pipeline of different diameters joined end to end so that the same discharge passes through each
the head lost to friction along the straight length of a pipe
the dimensionless ratio of inertia force to viscous force, fixed from density, velocity, diameter and viscosity
items.s: Pipes in parallel: two or more pipes connected between the same two junctions, sharing the total discharge with equal head loss. The other options describe Major loss, Reynolds number, Pipes in series.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Normal depth.
o: the dimensionless ratio of inertia force to gravity force, fixing whether flow is subcritical, critical or supercritical
flow whose Froude number is below one, controlled from downstream
the depth at which a channel carries a given discharge with uniform flow
the energy of flow in a channel measured with the bed as datum, the sum of depth and velocity head
items.s: Normal depth: the depth at which a channel carries a given discharge with uniform flow. The other options describe Froude number, Subcritical flow, Specific energy.

items.q: The correct meaning of Drag force is
o: the force exerted by a fluid on a body in the direction of flow
the part of drag caused by shear stress on a wetted surface
the part of drag caused by pressure differences around a body
the peeling away of the boundary layer from a surface under adverse pressure gradient
items.s: Drag force: the force exerted by a fluid on a body in the direction of flow. The other options describe Form drag, Boundary layer separation, Skin friction drag.
